info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Detail Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Detail Retrieval API enables users to access specific information regarding individual loans using their unique identifiers. It provides detailed insights into loan terms, outstanding balances, payment histories, and related data. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, app developers, and customer service interfaces requiring real-time loan information for reporting or client support purposes. By facilitating quick access to essential loan data, this API supports efficient decision-making and enhances customer engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve loan details for a specific deposit lending loan.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific deposit lending loan identified by its unique identifier. Users can access various details related to the loan, enabling informed decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. It contains necessary parameters to ensure accurate fetching of loan information.
